title: Stochastic Potential Choices and Outcomes
abstract: arXiv:2607.21413v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Applied econometricians typically model each individual as having fixed outcomes under treatment and control and, in instrumental-variables (IV) settings, fixed treatment decisions under each value of the instrument. This paper asks what changes when outcomes and treatment allocations or choices are stochastic at the individual level. In the model, each individual has a stable (but possibly stochastic) response type consisting of two objects: a treatment choice probability under each state and a potential outcome distribution under each treatment-state pair. These stochastic potential outcomes change the interpretation of some familiar estimators. For instance, in the deterministic IV model, the estimand identifies treatment effect only for compliers-those whose treatment status switches with the instrument. translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.21413v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：应用计量经济学家通常将每个个体建模为在治疗和控制下具有固定结果，并且在工具变量（IV）设定中，在每种工具值下具有固定的治疗决策。本文探讨当结果和治疗分配或选择在个体层面是随机时，会发生什么变化。在该模型中，每个个体具有一个稳定的（但可能是随机的）响应类型，由两个对象组成：每种状态下的治疗选择概率和每种治疗-状态对下的潜在结果分布。这些随机潜在结果改变了一些熟悉估计量的解释。例如，在确定性IV模型中，估计目标仅识别依从者（即治疗状态随工具变化的那部分个体）的治疗效应。在随机治疗分配或选择下，不存在这种离散子群体：估计目标在总体中平均效应。
tldr: 本文提出个体层面随机潜在结果模型，并指出该模型下传统IV估计量不再仅识别依从者，而是对总体效应进行平均，从而改变了对常见估计量的解释。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a model with individual-level stochastic potential outcomes and shows that, under such settings, the conventional IV estimand no longer identifies only compliers but averages effects over the population, altering the interpretation of familiar estimators.
